The combination of declining assets, shrinking equity, and the continuing losses, despite improvements in operational efficiency, creates a cautious outlook. The increased Debt-to-Equity Ratio further adds to the negative sentiment. While some areas have shown improvement, the negative trends outweigh the positives, leading to a slightly negative overall sentiment score of -0.2.
